analysis.title: GS US TMT: November Catalyst Watch (35+ Events)
key_insights: GS sales and trading desk lists 35+ TMT industry catalysts for November outside of company earnings, organized by week. This is a calendar note from the FICC and Equities business, not Global Investment Research.

Week of Nov 2: US midterm general elections 11/3, SNOW Expedition 2026 11/3-5 (CEO keynote Tuesday 1pm ET), WSJ Tech California conference 11/3-4, VEEV Investor Day 11/5 at 4:30pm ET, BOX BoxWorks 11/5-6.

Week of Nov 9: ENTG Investor Day 11/9 1pm ET, FLEX Investor Day 11/10 8:30am ET, FDS Investor Day 11/10 9am ET, LYV Investor Day 11/10 2pm ET, SEMICON Europa 11/10-13, China Internet Singles Day 11/11, BMO Tech Conference 11/12, AMZN TwitchCon 11/13-15.

Week of Nov 16 is the densest: NVDA earnings 11/17 post-market, MSFT Ignite 11/17-20 (CEO keynote Tuesday 1pm ET), ANGI Investor Day 11/17 8am ET, SABR Investor Day 11/17 8:30am ET, Dassault Systèmes Capital Markets Day 11/17 7am ET, ASML GS Field Trip in Connecticut 11/17, MH Investor Day 11/18 9am ET, NYT DealBook Summit 11/18.
TTWO's GTA VI launch is listed for 11/19. Also that week: SuperCompute 2026 with a GS hosting booth tour 11/16-17, TomorrowX Summit 11/17-18, SLUSH VC Conference 11/18-19, GS Hardware Bus Tour 11/19.
Week of Nov 23: GS EU AI and Semis Symposium 11/24-25 and Black Friday e-commerce 11/27.

Week of Nov 30: Cyber Monday 11/30, AWS re:Invent 11/30-12/4 (AWS CEO keynote Tuesday 11:30am ET), NVDA GTC Washington 11/30-12/3 (CEO keynote Tuesday 2pm ET), UBS TMT Conference 11/30-12/3, GS Japan Conference 11/30-12/4, GS EU Industrials & Autos Week 11/30-12/3, NSIT Investor Day 12/3, CRM AI Force World Tour at Javits Center 12/3.
earnings_insights: NVDA earnings are scheduled for 11/17 post-market (date only, no estimates given).
